etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text: The final り (ri) is likely by analogy with its antonym 左(ひだり) (hidari, “left”).

etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text:
The “right (direction)” and “respect, esteem, value” senses are from Middle Chinese 右 (MC hjuwX).
The “aid, assist” sense is from Middle Chinese 右 / 佑 (MC hjuwH).
The kan'on pronunciation, so likely a later borrowing.

etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text:
From Middle Chinese 右 (MC hjuwX).
The goon pronunciation, so likely the initial borrowing.

etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text: A denominal verb, from noun 曲 (kyoku, “something off, bent, or not quite right”) + る (-ru, generic verb-forming suffix).

etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text:
/dau/ → /dɔː/ → /doː/
/dou/ → /doː/
From Middle Chinese 道 (MC dawX). Compare modern Mandarin 道 (dào), Cantonese 道 (dou⁶).

etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text: Used as ateji in various names.
